programs.title: Wild Mississippi
programs.desc: A particularly cold winter caused much of the Mississippi to freeze.With spring came the melting of ice, which led to numerous floods and the river overflowing its bed.Documentarians look at how the local fauna and flora cope in these circumstances.It turns out that many predators try to take advantage of the opportunity and find easy prey among smaller creatures escaping from the water.Young ducks also face a significant challenge as they must quickly adapt to life in difficult conditions.
